0.name: TEXT_FESEST2021ADDPUBENPC_00713_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_001
0.description: (-Intellectual Voice from Head Height-)<hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, what an astounding coincidence! We have ventured across the seas to further educate ourselves in festival convention, and this “Hatching<hex:021F0103>tide” celebration is proving to be a veritable gold mine of new discoveries!

1.name: TEXT_FESEST2021ADDPUBENPC_00713_GYOREI_000_002
1.description: (-Alarmed Voice from Chest Height-)Would you please calm down! We're going to topple over if you keep flapping your fins like some agitated guppy!

2.name: TEXT_FESEST2021ADDPUBENPC_00713_GYOSHIN_000_003
2.description: (-Complaining Voice from Groin Height-)This will be over soon, yes, yes? It's so hot in here, my scales are drying out... And carrying all this weight is making me dizzy.

3.name: TEXT_FESEST2021ADDPUBENPC_00713_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_004
3.description: (-Intellectual Voice from Head Height-)Have you no shame!? <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> must be appalled at your lack of fortitude! I shall have to assign you exercises from the <hex:021A020203>Mystique of the Perfect Physique<hex:021A020103> upon our return!

4.name: TEXT_FESEST2021ADDPUBENPC_00713_LEOFARD_000_005
4.description: Ah hells... You're the last person I wanted to meet in this fool's costume. I s'pose you've been the “ever-helpful adventurer” while this is all goin' on, eh?

5.name: TEXT_FESEST2021ADDPUBENPC_00713_STACIA_000_006
5.description: For our part, we just drifted in for a...minor business opportunity, but our, er, “business partner” thought we'd blend in better if we dressed the part.

6.name: TEXT_FESEST2021ADDPUBENPC_00713_UTATA_000_007
6.description: And what with all the excitement and the celebrating, we sort of forgot to change! It really <hex:021A020203>is<hex:021A020103> rather fun, though.

7.name: TEXT_FESEST2021ADDPUBENPC_00713_LEOFARD_000_008
7.description: Aye, well, we got paid extra to be festival-goers, but I reckon it's almost time we left. See you in the clouds, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

8.name: TEXT_FESEST2021ADDPUBENPC_00713_LEOFARD_000_009
8.description: For the love of rum, how much longer do we have to wear these fool costumes?

9.name: TEXT_FESEST2021ADDPUBENPC_00713_STACIA_000_010
9.description: For as long as it takes us to conclude our business here. We were paid extra to blend in, so that's what we're doin'. Chin up, Captain, we've put up with worse.

10.name: TEXT_FESEST2021ADDPUBENPC_00713_UTATA_000_011
10.description: And you know, this really <hex:021A020203>is<hex:021A020103> a rather fun change of pace.

11.name: TEXT_FESEST2021ADDPUBENPC_00713_GODBERT_000_015
11.description: Oho! If it isn't <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, my dear son's mighty companion! In town for a spot of Hatching<hex:021F0103>tide festivity, are we?

12.name: TEXT_FESEST2021ADDPUBENPC_00713_GODBERT_000_016
12.description: If Hildy were here, we might have enjoyed the celebrations as one big, happy Manderville family, but we've seen neither hide nor hair of the boy for some time now...

13.name: TEXT_FESEST2021ADDPUBENPC_00713_JULYAN_000_017
13.description: Where could our beloved son have gone!? Should ye happen to run across our wayward whelp, ye let him know that his mum and dad are worried bloody sick!

14.name: TEXT_FESEST2021ADDPUBENPC_00713_GODBERT_000_018
14.description: If our son were here, we could enjoy the celebrations as one big, happy Manderville family, but we've seen neither hide nor hair of the boy for some time now...

15.name: TEXT_FESEST2021ADDPUBENPC_00713_JULYAN_000_019
15.description: Godsdammit all! Where could our beloved child be!?

16.name: TEXT_FESEST2021ADDPUBENPC_00713_EDITHA_000_025
16.description: Oooh, it's my favorite bodyguard! Are you here to flit and frolic as well?

17.name: TEXT_FESEST2021ADDPUBENPC_00713_LASSENCHOU_000_026
17.description: Concerts in the amphitheatre are suspended while the festival is ongoing, of course, but our talented harpsichordist here is now enjoying a blessedly peaceful career!

18.name: TEXT_FESEST2021ADDPUBENPC_00713_LASSENCHOU_000_027
18.description: As I keep telling her, however, a successful artist must exercise the proper precautions! If she insists on prancing around without an escort, then she must wear a disguise...and these full-body costumes are just the ticket!

19.name: TEXT_FESEST2021ADDPUBENPC_00713_EDITHA_000_028
19.description: But it's hot and uncomfortable and sooo hard to see! One's head was meant to be free! You agree with me, don't you?

20.name: TEXT_FESEST2021ADDPUBENPC_00713_LASSENCHOU_000_029
20.description: You will endure the bunny head and keep your features hidden! Must I harp on and on about the dangers of leaving home without a proper escort!?

21.name: TEXT_FESEST2021ADDPUBENPC_00713_EDITHA_000_030
21.description: But it's hot and uncomfortable and sooo hard to see! One's head was meant to be free!

22.name: TEXT_FESEST2021ADDPUBENPC_00713_SILVAIRRE_000_035
22.description: ...What do you want? Are you come to mock me and my laughable appearance?

23.name: TEXT_FESEST2021ADDPUBENPC_00713_LEIHALIAPOH_000_036
23.description: That's enough of that, Silvairre! We represent the guild's community spirit for the duration of the festival, so you'd best be giving everyone your happiest cluck!

24.name: TEXT_FESEST2021ADDPUBENPC_00713_SILVAIRRE_000_037
24.description: Cluck... Ugh, I should have thought twice before agreeing to this duty.

25.name: TEXT_FESEST2021ADDPUBENPC_00713_LEIHALIAPOH_000_038
25.description: Never mind this wet blanket, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Please, enjoy the celebrations!

26.name: TEXT_FESEST2021ADDPUBENPC_00713_LEIHALIAPOH_000_039
26.description: Oh, do cheer up! We represent the guild's community spirit for the duration of the festival, so you'd best be giving everyone your happiest cluck!

27.name: TEXT_FESEST2021ADDPUBENPC_00713_SILVAIRRE_000_040
27.description: Cluck... Ugh, I should have thought twice before agreeing to this duty.
